about.hero_desc: LockOnRevision transforms the way students approach study by turning consistency into a visible, competitive scoring system.
about.beta_desc: LockOnRevision is currently in Beta. We’re continuously improving the platform through student feedback, testing, and regular feature updates as we work towards a full production release.
about.what_desc: LockOnRevision is a competitive revision platform designed for students who want to study smarter, stay consistent, and see their progress in real time. Instead of relying on passive rereading, students complete structured lessons, earn XP, collect Energy, and compete on a leaderboard that rewards genuine effort. The platform combines AI-powered tools — from lesson generation to intelligent tutoring — with a clean, focused interface that eliminates distractions.
about.mission_desc: To make every study session count by giving students immediate, visible feedback on their effort. We believe consistency, not cramming, is the foundation of real learning — and we build tools that make consistent revision feel rewarding.
about.vision_desc: A world where every student has access to a personal revision ecosystem that adapts to their needs, celebrates their progress, and connects them with a community of learners striving for excellence.
about.why_desc: Most study tools treat revision as a solo, invisible activity. Students put in hours without knowing whether the work is compounding. LockOnRevision changes that by making progress measurable, visible, and socially engaging. We exist to replace the question “Did I study enough?” with “What do I need to do next?”
about.features_heading: Everything you need to revise effectively.
about.feature_xp_scoring_desc: Every completed lesson awards XP, giving students a clear measure of their revision volume.
about.feature_energy_system_desc: Energy rewards high-quality performance and unit completion. Each Energy point is worth 100 XP on the leaderboard.
about.feature_leaderboard_desc: Students are ranked by total score, making consistency visible and motivating healthy competition.
about.feature_forge_desc: An AI-powered learning path generator that turns uploaded notes into structured lessons and revision units.
about.feature_timetable_desc: Plan and track revision sessions with an integrated timetable that adapts to your workload.
about.feature_admin_desc: Cohort management, score audits, Energy rule tuning, and access controls for authorised teams.
about.ai_heading: Intelligent tools that adapt to you.
about.ai_desc: LockORevision leverages Google Gemini AI to power a suite of smart features that make revision more efficient, personalised, and interactive.
about.ai_lesson_gen_desc: Upload your notes and Forge generates structured lessons with explanations, examples, and key takeaways.
about.ai_tutor_chat_desc: Ask questions about any topic and receive contextual responses based on your revision material.
about.ai_wrong_answer_desc: When you answer incorrectly, the AI explains why and reinforces the correct concept.
about.ai_curriculum_desc: Forge structures your notes into a coherent learning path, identifying prerequisites and logical progressions.
about.ai_hinting_desc: Stuck on a question? The AI provides targeted hints to guide you toward the answer without giving it away.
about.ai_timetable_desc: AI-assisted timetable generation helps plan your revision sessions based on your available time and goals.
about.highlight_student_first_desc: Every feature is built around the student experience, from onboarding to daily revision.
about.highlight_gamified_desc: XP, Energy, and leaderboards turn study into a rewarding game without losing academic focus.
about.highlight_ai_native_desc: AI is not an add-on — it is woven into lesson generation, tutoring, and timetable planning.
about.highlight_privacy_desc: User data is protected through Firebase security rules and authentication.
about.highlight_cross_platform_desc: Built as a responsive web application that works on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
about.highlight_community_desc: Discord and leaderboard features foster a supportive community of learners.
about.team_abhijay_bio1: Abhijay Jalagari is the Founder, Chief Executive Officer (CEO), and primary Brand Representative of LockOnRevision, a student-focused EdTech platform dedicated to helping learners stay organized, motivated, and confident during exam preparation.
about.team_abhijay_bio2: Motivated by his own experiences as a student, he founded LockOnRevision with the vision of making revision more engaging, structured, and accessible through technology. As CEO, Abhijay leads the platform’s overall vision, product direction, and innovation while actively gathering feedback from students to ensure every feature solves real educational challenges.
about.team_abhijay_bio3: Beyond leadership, Abhijay represents LockOnRevision in presentations, competitions, demonstrations, and school initiatives, serving as the public face of the project.
about.team_abhijay_mission_desc: To empower students worldwide with engaging and effective revision tools that transform studying into a rewarding experience.
about.team_mayank_bio1: Mayank Ghosh is the Founder, Chief Operating Officer (COO), and Lead Developer of LockOnRevision, an AI-powered personalised learning platform designed to make revision smarter, more engaging, and accessible for students.
about.team_mayank_bio2: As founder, he leads the product vision, ensuring every feature solves real problems students face while studying. He believes revision should be adaptive, motivating, and tailored to each learner instead of relying on generic study methods.
about.team_mayank_bio3: As COO, he oversees product strategy, feature planning, and the overall direction of the platform. He focuses on balancing educational value with an intuitive user experience, making sure new features support long-term growth and scalability.
about.team_mayank_bio4: As Lead Developer, he architects and builds much of the platform, working across AI-powered revision tools, personalised study plans, adaptive learning systems, gamification and progression mechanics, UX improvements, full-stack development, deployment, and production management.
about.team_mayank_bio5: Beyond writing code, Mayank combines technical development with product leadership, often making decisions on feature prioritisation, usability, and long-term platform strategy. He actively researches modern technologies and AI tools to continuously improve LockOnRevision.
about.team_mayank_vision_desc: To build one of the most student-centred revision platforms by combining artificial intelligence, personalised learning, and thoughtful design to help learners study more effectively while making revision feel rewarding rather than repetitive.
about.built_by_desc: LockOnRevision was created by students who experienced the same revision challenges faced by millions of learners. Every feature is designed using real classroom experiences and student feedback to ensure the platform remains practical, engaging, and genuinely helpful.
about.contact_desc: Have questions, feedback, or interested in contributing? Reach out to us through any of the channels below.
